On Reading Slowly in a Fast World

We are told that speed is a virtue. Read faster, skim more, consume everything. But the books that change us are rarely the ones we finish in an afternoon.

Slowness is not laziness. It is a way of giving a sentence the time it needs to become an idea.

Designing for the page you land on

An interface that ignores its host is a guest who rearranges the furniture. Surfaces should borrow the room's light.
